description: In front of you on a bed are several microfiber cloths: a large lime-green cloth on the left with other colors peeking from underneath, and a small stack of folded yellow cloths near the upper right. The left hand pinches a small folded green cloth at the lower right, lifts it up and to the left, places it on top of the yellow stack, then moves back to the large cloth and pulls the top green layer up and left to unfold it, exposing a blue cloth underneath while the hand continues holding the edge.
